name: Kumon Kaede
source:
In an effort to pay for his high cost living, Kaede works day and night as a part-time worker to support himself. As a result, his grades have suffered greatly, and a feud with his teacher Murashige has put his advancement to the next grade at risk. In addition, conflict between him and a band of delinquents has left him without any friends.

However, something will help change Kaede's situation. It can only happen though if he can learn to trust his roommate, Ichiro.
